header.title: Industry experience
header.lead: 27+ years of buyer-side global sourcing leadership with Walmart, Li & Fung, William E. Connor and Decathlon: the practice behind her teaching and research.

industry.title: Industry leadership experience
industry.summary: Over 27 years of progressive buyer-side global sourcing and supply chain management across US, UK, European and Asian retail and brand organisations, spanning supplier evaluation, product and brand merchandising, production governance, quality and social compliance, and multi-functional team building.

items.role: Director, Global Sourcing and Supply Chain
items.text: Leads global sourcing advisory, supply chain governance, and CSR/ESG and audit-readiness consulting for manufacturers serving international buyers.

Established regional sourcing teams, onboarded new client accounts, and led supplier capability, capacity and compliance readiness for US/EU private and licensed brands, including Walmart, Target, Disney/Marvel and Primark.
Directed apparel supplier selection, costing and development alignment, performance evaluation and capability upgrading with category, quality and compliance teams.
Built and led apparel and accessories merchandising and sourcing teams, aligning local execution with regional Hong Kong sourcing leadership.

items.org: Li & Fung (Vietnam) Ltd., Just Jamie UK Team
items.text: Directed local operations and apparel merchandising for a 30-person office of merchandisers, technicians and QA, reporting directly to the Chief Representative.
Managed technical production, product quality execution, and factory audit and compliance governance.
Executed end-to-end garment merchandising, production follow-up and buyer coordination for international retail accounts.
